reported.title: Fan relay chatters at threshold due to no hysteresis
reported.description: The control logic at lines 72-79 sets the fan ON whenever tempC >= OPEN_C and OFF otherwise, with no hysteresis band and no debounce. Any noise around 28.0 C flips the output every 50 ms tick, producing the measured 46 toggles in a 5000 ms window (limit 2) and 64 toggles over the run. The spec's 24.0 C close threshold is never used, so the required deadband is absent. D9 toggled 46 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.30 s (limit 2), and 64 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

reported.title: No fault detection: sub-5 C and floating probe drive fan OFF
reported.description: readTempC (lines 19-24) returns the raw scaled value with no validity check, and the control branch at lines 72-79 treats any reading below OPEN_C as a normal 'fan OFF' command. A 0 V disconnected probe or a 3 C cold reading therefore forces the fan OFF instead of the required safe ON, leaving D9 not HIGH for 5400 ms and 3010 ms respectively against the 600 ms allowance. There is no fault branch anywhere in loop() to force and hold the safe state. During the fault, D9 was not in safe state HIGH for 5400 ms (allowed 600 ms to react).

judge_input.spec:
- LM35 greenhouse air probe on A2 at 10 mV/°C; exhaust fan relay on D9.
- Open the fan when temperature reaches 28.0 °C or above; close the fan when temperature falls to 24.0 °C or below.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- If the probe is floating, or temperature reads below 5.0 °C or above 100.0 °C, force the fan ON within 600 ms and hold that safe state for the duration of the fault.
- Print `gh: <temp> C fan=ON` or `gh: <temp> C fan=OFF` every 1000 ms with temperature to one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained in-range band crossing.
